content.short: Corporate cards, spend management, bill pay and business accounts.
content.description: Brex, founded in 2017, is a US financial software platform used by tens of thousands of companies to manage corporate spend. It offers corporate credit cards, business accounts with treasury and yield, expense management, bill pay, reimbursements, and travel booking, unified by AI-driven automation and deep accounting integrations. Brex is designed for startups and enterprises that want real-time visibility and control over company spending, replacing legacy corporate card programs and manual expense tools. Because it sits at the center of card transactions, reimbursements, and vendor payments, Brex creates a rich stream of financial data where categorization, approvals, and reconciliation are core to the product.
